question: Where is the engine oil dipstick located?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Engine oil dipstick (on vehicles without deep water fording kit) is located behind alternator on left side of engine and removed to check engine oil level. -> Action: Check engine oil level [Manual page 306].

**Other relevant information**
• Engine oil dipstick (on vehicles with deep water fording kit) is located behind alternator on left side of engine and is removed to check engine oil level. [Manual page 62].
• Engine oil filler cap is located front center of engine. [Manual page 62].

**Limitations**
The table only lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
